## Architectural Boundaries & Isolation
- Consumed as an in-process library dependency (`pydantic-ai-slim`).
- Strictly isolated behind `PlannerProtocol` and `PydanticAiPlanner` domain abstractions.
- Model generation produces non-authoritative `PlanSchema` proposals; never bypasses deterministic validation (`PlanValidator`).
- No vendor lock-in: provider integration operates via neutral abstraction.

## Attribution & Usage Policy
- Import and consume unmodified binary wheels as versioned package dependencies.
- Retain standard MIT copyright notice in release documentation and third-party manifests.
- Zero copy-pasting of upstream framework internals into IR application core.
